adaptations.withheld: sacred or restricted dance: no teaching adaptations

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Crisp adavus with fluid variations and large-scale movements.
movement_profile.footwork: Intricate tapping that explores different time measures; discourages hard stamping against the floor.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Soloist moving across a wide scale; uses both loka dharmi and natya dharmi.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Supported by a protective cotton belt; requires high flexibility for wide-scale movements.
movement_profile.posture: Standard Bharatanatyam araimandi (half-sit), but with larger amplitude in limb extensions.

signature_moves.description: Intricate tapping footwork exploring different time measures in different tempos.
signature_moves.name: Suddha Nrittam

signature_moves.description: Dance performed while balancing on a clay pot.
signature_moves.name: Perani Natyam

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Highly dynamic, shifting between various tempos and rhythmic gaits.
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid stamping the feet hard against the floor; avoid items glorifying human patrons.

music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Gati bhedas in every jati; intricate tapping patterns
music_profile.sound_description: The sound is defined by the sophisticated use of ankle bells which produce a rich variety of rhythmic tones without the thud of hard stamping. The music follows Carnatic structures but is marked by frequent and complex shifts in gait and time measures.

basic_steps: Suddha Nrittam tapping (intricate footwork exploring different time measures)
Controlled salangai usage (producing sound without hard stamping)
Large amplitude adavus (executing basic steps with wide range)
Gati bhedam (practicing gait changes within a rhythmic cycle)
Spontaneous abhinaya (linking facial expression to each body movement)
teaching.formation: Primarily solo performance, utilizing a wide spatial scale.
teaching.level_notes: Considered the most physically demanding Bharatanatyam style due to tempo scales and amplitude.
teaching.rhythm: Complex, featuring pancha nadais (five rhythms) and frequent gati bhedas.
